‎ ‎Governor Umo Eno of Akwa Ibom State has promised to reconstruct the Technical College, Ikot Akata, and upgrade the Ukam Market in Mkpat Enin Local Government Area if the people deliver 100 per cent of the votes to him in the 2027 general elections. ‎ ‎Eno made the promise on Monday during the flag-off of the All Progressives Congress Local Government campaign tour at the Mkpat Enin Local Government Stadium. ‎ ‎The governor, who is seeking re-election on the platform of the APC, said the projects would be executed in his second term as a reward for the loyalty and support of the people of the area. ‎ ‎He said, “Mkpat Enin holds a special place in my heart, especially being the hometown of my late wife, Pastor Patience Umo Eno. I want to appeal for your love and support. ‎ ‎”I am not a scammer, and I don’t know how to scam. I will rebuild the secondary school in Ikot Akata, the Ukam Market, and other projects in Mkpat Enin Local Government Area.” ‎ ‎Eno said his administration will continue to execute tangible projects that will attract development to the people, urging voters to rally behind him for a second term. ‎ ‎He urged residents to vote massively for President Bola Tinubu, himself, and all APC candidates in 2027, assuring them that his second term would focus on consolidating development and shifting from an infrastructure-driven economy to a more productive economy. ‎ ‎The governor said the campaign across the 31 local government areas would be peaceful and charged party leaders to take the message to wards and units across the state. Emem Julius
